Nomura is hiring a Software Development Engineer in Test for its Global Markets IT team. The role builds automated testing infrastructure and quality practices for mission-critical trading platforms, integrating testing into CI/CD and supporting resilient, reliable production systems.
Banking
Finance
Financial Services
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Design, build, and scale automated testing frameworks from scratch for mission-critical OMS/EMS platforms, pricing engines, and position-marking systems
Own end-to-end test automation for real-time trading workflows, market data integration, and regulatory reporting pipelines
Build test harnesses that validate nanosecond-latency order routing, exchange connectivity, and risk calculations
Embed automated test suites into continuous integration/deployment pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
Enable multiple daily deployments to production through robust quality gates and automated regression coverage
Champion shift-left testing practices across engineering teams transitioning to modern architecture
Partner directly with front office sales and trading to understand market workflows and trading scenarios
Work with compliance teams to automate regulatory testing for trade surveillance, audit trails, and reporting accuracy
Collaborate with middle office and external clients to validate reconciliation, P&L attribution, and settlement workflows
Conduct code reviews with developers, advocate for testability, and drive quality standards across the engineering organization
Build test data generation pipelines that mirror live market conditions and high-volume trading scenarios
Own root-cause analysis for test failures, flaky tests, and production defects
Establish observability and synthetic monitoring for critical trading paths
Qualification
Python
Java
C#

Pytest

Required
Programming proficiency: Strong command of Python, Java, C#, or JavaScript/TypeScript—you write production-quality code, not just test scripts
Testing expertise: Deep understanding of unit, integration, API, contract, and end-to-end testing trade-offs; experience with testing frameworks (pytest, JUnit, TestNG, Jest, Cypress)
DevOps & CI/CD: Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI; comfortable with infrastructure-as-code
Understanding of order management systems (OMS), execution management systems (EMS), or FIX protocol
Familiarity with listed derivatives (options, futures), pricing models, or position-keeping concepts
Experience testing low-latency, high-throughput systems where performance and correctness are critical
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
0–3 years of professional experience in software development, SDET, or quality engineering roles
Demonstrable coding ability through personal projects, open-source contributions, or internships
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to learn complex domain concepts quickly
Excellent communication skills—you'll be working across technology, trading, and business teams
Benefits
The total compensation package for this position may also include a sign-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards, dependent on the position offered.
A full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave; details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.
